_comment: Default thresholds, used when no calibration labels are available or a category has too few labels to tune. Every value here is generic (not tied to any dataset); calibration overrides the per-category flag thresholds and records what it chose in calibration.json.

check_params._comment: asr_min_deleted_words: 2 (was 3; D48): two long words cut from speech were missed, and on 180 real outputs the lower minimum added only real errors (bracketed text Indic-Speak skipped). entity_missing_score: a source name or acronym found neither in the translation (Latin or transliterated) nor in the back-translation; single words score 0.1 less. Below every default flag threshold on purpose: alone it is a hint (names are often translated or written as exonyms, e.g. BCE -> கி.மு, Satluj -> শতদ্রু), and it flags only together with the judge or the back-translation (D46).

judge._comment: replicas: re-ordered prompts per item; a disagreement adds replicas up to max_replicas (tie-break). repeat_sample: share of items (chosen by hash) whose first prompt is re-sent unchanged to measure repeat-consistency. Translations longer than window_tokens whitespace tokens are judged in overlapping windows; items needing more than max_windows are skipped (cost guard). models: optional jury, empty = LLM_MODEL.

clients._comment: Retry and concurrency policy shared by the Bodhan and LLM clients (K11, D43). Back-off is retry_base_s * 2^attempt with jitter; a Retry-After header is honoured up to retry_max_wait_s and pauses the whole service; after aimd_increase_after consecutive successes a service's concurrency grows by one (it halves on HTTP 429). A call keeps waiting out HTTP 429 for up to rate_limit_patience_s after its first one (15 min: the 23 Nov clean run saw Retry-After of 8-58 s for minutes at a time); errors (5xx, timeouts) still stop after max_retries attempts.
